name: aliased state in tsx component
source: import { $state as state } from 'fict'; export function Counter(props: { initial: number }) { const count = state(props.initial); return <button>{count}</button>; }

name: shadowed macro spelling
source: import { $state as state } from 'fict'; export function Counter() { const count = state(0); function read(state: (value: number) => number) { return state(1); } return count + read(value => value); }

name: function directives and type-only import
source: import type { Shape } from './shape'; export function useShape(value: Shape) { 'use no memo'; 'use pure'; return value; }

name: configured reactive callback
source: import { renderHook } from './host'; import { $state } from 'fict'; renderHook(() => { const value = $state(0); return value; });

name: typescript enum and namespace
source: enum Mode { Off, On = 4 } namespace Tools { export const mode = Mode.On; } export const value = Tools.mode;

name: props-derived resource key and event callback
source: import { resource } from 'fict/plus'; const posts = resource(async (_context, id: number) => ({ id })); export function App(props: { userId: number; onSelect: (id: number) => void }) { const userId = props.userId; const result = posts.read(userId); return <button onClick={() => props.onSelect(result.data?.id ?? userId)}>{result.data?.id}</button>; }

name: module state owner
legacyMessage: must be declared inside a component or hook function body

name: nested state owner
source: import { $state } from 'fict'; export function App() { function Child() { const count = $state(0); return {count}; } return ; }
legacyMessage: cannot be declared inside nested functions

name: conditional state
source: import { $state } from 'fict'; export function App() { if (ready) { const count = $state(0); } return null; }
legacyMessage: cannot be declared inside loops or conditionals

name: conditional effect
source: import { $effect } from 'fict'; export function App() { if (ready) $effect(() => work()); return null; }
legacyMessage: cannot be called inside loops or conditionals

name: module direct hook
legacyMessage: must be called inside a component or hook

name: conditional namespace hook
source: import * as hooks from './hooks'; export function App() { if (ready) hooks.useCounter(); return <div />; }
legacyMessage: must be called at the top level of a component or hook

name: namespace macro call
legacyMessage: cannot be called through a namespace import
